meta.pipeline: helpers imported unchanged from run_two_mode_lmo.build_frame / run_pose_error.pose_metrics
meta.frame_selection: scene_gt_info.px_count_visib >= 1200; evenly spaced over the sequence; 100 attempts per object; selection never looks at K or at the estimator output
meta.metric_mesh: models/ (byte-identical to the LINEMOD meshes); models_eval is the secondary adds_eval_m column
meta.note: GT-pose correspondences: a controlled estimator experiment on real cost functions, not a detector; no front-end and no accuracy claim against published BOP pipelines.

mesh_identity.note: ADD-S primary mesh = models/, byte-identical to the LINEMOD meshes cited in results/pose_error.json; models_eval is the secondary column.

starts_check_2x.note: find_modes re-run with 2x starts (768) on the identical reduced cost; K and hard argmin compared with the primary 384-start run.

pixel_roundtrip.note: max |(K U)/(KU)_z - original mask_visib pixel| over the SQPNP frames; 0 proves the baseline sees the same 2-D points.

shift_check.note: The 2-D depth/mask shift spot check was run in run_two_mode_lmo.py on the 37-frame sample and found that integer (dx,dy) shifts do not explain the depth-model residual; it is not repeated here (cost), so the LMO residual is cited from that run, not re-derived.
